review_candidates.title: Junior PKI Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Egypt Trust - إيجيبت تراست is a trusted legal certificate service provider in Egypt, specializing in digital signatures and information security solutions. As a VeriSign Affiliate, the company operates under recognized international standards for secure digital transactions and identity verification. Egypt Trust supports organizations and institutions in protecting their data integrity and ensuring the legal validity of electronic documents. The company offers a professional environment for technology and security specialists who want to contribute to the growth of secure digital services in Egypt. Role Description The Junior PKI Engineer supports the operation, administration, monitoring, and maintenance of Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) systems and Digital Trust Services. The role is responsible for supporting Certificate Authorities (CAs), Registration Authorities (RAs), OCSP services, Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs), Timestamping Services (TSA), Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), and related PKI applications. The Junior PKI Engineer works under the guidance of senior PKI engineers and follows approved security procedures, operational processes, and applicable regulatory and compliance requirements. Key Responsibilities 1. PKI Operations Support the daily operation and monitoring of PKI infrastructure. Monitor CA, RA, OCSP, TSA, and related PKI services. Assist with certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, and suspension activities. Monitor certificate and CA service status and report abnormalities. Support CRL generation, publication, and monitoring. Support OCSP service monitoring and troubleshooting. Perform routine PKI operational checks according to approved procedures. Escalate critical incidents and service failures to the PKI Manager/Senior Engineer. 2. Certificate Authority Administration Assist with administration and maintenance of Issuing CA environments. Support CA configuration activities under supervision. Assist in certificate profile and certificate template configuration. Verify certificate extensions and attributes according to approved certificate policies. Support CA database and service health monitoring. Assist with CA certificate renewal and certificate lifecycle activities. Support CA migration, upgrade, and maintenance activities. 3. HSM Operations Assist with day-to-day HSM operational activities under approved procedures. Monitor HSM status, availability, and connectivity. Assist with HSM backup and synchronization activities. Support HSM partition/slot administration under supervision. Maintain HSM inventory and operational documentation. Participate in key ceremonies as an operational/support member when authorized. Strictly follow M-of-N, dual-control, segregation-of-duties, and key-management procedures. Required Technical Knowledge PKI & Cryptography Basic understanding of Public Key Infrastructure. Understanding of X.509 certificates. Knowledge of certificate lifecycle management. Understanding of Certificate Authorities (Root CA and Issuing CA). Basic understanding of CRL and OCSP. Basic understanding of TSA and RFC 3161. Understanding of certificate chains and trust models. Basic knowledge of digital signatures and public-key cryptography. Familiarity with RSA and ECC. Basic understanding of symmetric and asymmetric cryptography. HSM Basic understanding of Hardware Security Modules. Understanding of secure key storage. Basic knowledge of cryptographic key lifecycle. Familiarity with HSM concepts such as partitions/slots, authentication, backup, and key management is preferred. Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, Electronics/Communication Engineering, or a related field. Experience 0–2 years of experience in PKI, cybersecurity, infrastructure, system administration, or a related technical field. Fresh graduates with relevant PKI, cybersecurity, cryptography, or infrastructure training may be considered.

review_candidates.title: Director of Operations, Slate Development
review_candidates.description: Scopely is looking for a Director, Slate Operations to join our Slate Development Group team in the UK remotely or in Barcelona, on a flexible hybrid model. At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. Slate Operations keeps Scopely's game development slate moving. We oversee execution and cross-functional alignment across the games in development — connecting game teams and central teams so decisions get made once and stick, running the cadence that keeps everyone aligned, and clearing the path so teams can build. What You'll Do We're looking for a Director, Slate Operations to own this end to end. There are two sides to it: keeping the Group running as an organization — its cadence, process, and the day-to-day support the Game Board, Head of Slate Development and leadership team rely on — and running program management for the Game Development Framework (GDF) so games move cleanly from concept to launch. You'll sit inside the Slate Development Group but work with every part of Scopely: game teams, divisional leadership, finance, strategy, and corporate development. Be the operational point of contact for specific in-development games — running the GDF cadence and connecting game and central teams so decisions get made once and aren't re-litigated. The main goal is to be the end to end steward for game teams in the game development framework. Deliver operational excellence within our internal team, shaping our service model, priorities, and ways of working. Evolve our capabilities as needs change. Drive the cross-slate operating model so independent game teams reuse what already works instead of rebuilding it. Bring structure to consequential decisions — organize the inputs, assumptions, and trade-offs early so the owners and the room can reach real alignment before committing. Own a capstone project — one meaty area you drive end to end, for example: evolving the GDF, owning launch readiness, or operationalizing central partnerships, depending on where the need is. Keep investment decisions well-informed — track progress across games at different stages, and surface Greenlight Case, budget, staffing, and dependency status so leadership can challenge and decide. Unblock teams through the development cycle, especially at launch readiness, by clearing operational issues with central partners (legal, IT, procurement, finance, logistics) so teams stay focused on the game. Partner with marketing, strategy, and divisional leadership so launches go out clean. Give teams operational support — production perspective, process, facilitation, and help navigating the GDF. Operationalize playtests and validation — help build and run research, playtest, and validation plans, and package the findings so vertical owners and leaders can form the recommendation. Utilize the latest AI technologies to keep information flowing — the dashboards, status, and key dates people need to see, without the overhead. What We’re Looking For Bachelor's degree, MBA a plus — or the equivalent in experience. 10+ years in program/project management across tech and direct-to-consumer businesses, at least 5 of them in games, working within or alongside a development team. You know how games get made and sold — development, publishing, platforms, business models. You don't need to have shipped one yourself, but you get what game teams are up against. You've supported senior execs in a fast-moving environment and you like the pace — taking initiative, juggling priorities, switching gears without losing the thread. You can run a lot of projects at once, ideally a mix of R&D and live. You're comfortable in ambiguity and good at creating clarity for other people. You make sound calls in the company's interest and know when to escalate. You can hold your own with P&Ls and free-to-play KPIs. You spot the process that's slowing people down and fix it — and you'll push back and start the right debate when it matters. You build trust with all kinds of people at every level and don't flinch at the hard conversations — with the presence to grow into a partner to senior game leaders over time. You write clearly and fast, and you can build a strong deck with cross-functional input. Detail and organization come naturally to you. Low ego, business outcomes first, open to feedback — and genuinely curious about every part of the business. You play games and care about the industry. About Scopely Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play. Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come. Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play. Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/. Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely.com. Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice. Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

The role is strongly hands-on . The selected consultant must have personally implemented and used the requested technologies during the last five years, rather than managed or delegated these activities to others. The objective is to ensure the quality, reliability, security, scalability, and performance of a large-scale digital platform through extensive test automation and continuous quality engineering. The consultant will work within Agile delivery teams and contribute to the modernization of a strategic digital transformation program. Your missions: Define, maintain, and operationalize the overall testing approach and testing strategy. Design and implement Agile operational test plans covering both business and technical validation. Establish and maintain automated testing frameworks across all testing layers. Ensure software quality, robustness, security, scalability, and performance. Validate business logic implemented within APIs and microservices. Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. Contribute to observability, monitoring, logging, and quality controls. Support Agile teams throughout the entire delivery lifecycle. Provide technical recommendations and propose alternative solutions when required. Promote Continuous Testing and Quality Engineering best practices. Actively contribute to sprint activities such as planning, refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and demonstrations. Continuously evaluate and adopt new tools, technologies, and testing practices. Your activities: Test Strategy & Planning Develop and continuously improve the testing roadmap and test approach. Create and maintain Agile operational test plans. Define and execute quality assurance processes for the solution landscape. Functional Testing Validate business processes implemented through APIs and microservices. Verify data integrity across the solution. Perform end-to-end testing of business and user journeys. API Testing Validate OpenAPI contracts. Test API functionality, performance, security, and compatibility. Automate API testing to support continuous integration and delivery. Implement and maintain API testing frameworks and tooling. Integration Testing Test interactions between microservices. Validate integrations with COTS products, external APIs, adapters, and third-party systems. Simulate failure scenarios and resilience use cases. Security Testing Validate authentication, authorization, and encryption mechanisms. Verify compliance with Zero Trust and secure architecture principles. Performance Engineering Design and execute performance, stress, load, and scalability testing. Assess the behavior of APIs, microservices, and the overall platform under load. Test Automation Design, build, and maintain automated regression, integration, API, UI, and E2E test suites. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. Ensure rapid feedback within DevOps delivery processes. Monitoring & Observability Contribute to monitoring, logging, and observability setup across development, test, and acceptance environments. Implement and maintain quality insights and operational monitoring dashboards. Agile Collaboration Work closely with developers, analysts, architects, and business stakeholders. Participate actively in all Agile ceremonies. Share knowledge, mentor team members, and promote engineering excellence. You have the following skills: MandatoryExperience 10+ years of experience as a Test Engineer. Higher education degree in Computer Science (short-cycle or university level). Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience within Agile delivery teams. Test Automation & Quality Engineering Test automation frameworks (5+ years). API testing frameworks and tools (5+ years). UI testing frameworks and tools (5+ years). End-to-End testing (5+ years). Regression testing (5+ years). Integration testing (5+ years). Contract testing (5+ years). Mocking and service virtualization (5+ years). Performance Testing Performance, load, and stress testing (5+ years). Ideally with JMeter and Gatling . API & Microservices API testing and validation. API contract validation (OpenAPI). Microservices testing. Integration testing within distributed environments. Programming & Scripting Java SE 10+ (minimum 3 years). Python (5+ years). JavaScript (5+ years). CI/CD & DevOps CI/CD pipeline implementation (5+ years). Integration of automated tests in CI/CD pipelines (5+ years). Preferably Azure DevOps. Build tools experience (5+ years). Preferably Maven. Monitoring & Observability Monitoring and observability implementation (5+ years). Preferably Grafana. Databases SQL databases (minimum 3 years). Soft Skills Strong analytical mindset. Ability to propose alternatives and recommendations. Excellent communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong listening skills. Flexible attitude. Team player. Positive hands-on "can-do" mentality. Languages English: professional proficiency. French or Dutch: professional proficiency. Nice-to-Have API design and development. Microservices development and integration. Software architecture and design (Cloud, APIs, Microservices, Event-driven). Event-Driven Architecture (EDA). Event-Driven Development. Behavior-Driven Development (BDD). Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Knowledge of existing federal-government building blocks and services. Experience working in cloud-native environments. Understanding of secure-by-design and Zero Trust architectures.

review_candidates.description: Vill du arbeta med kritisk IT-infrastruktur och säkerställa att verksamhetens data alltid är tillgänglig och skyddad? Vi söker en Systemadministratör med inriktning mot Storage & Backup som vill arbeta med drift, utveckling och förvaltning av större IT-miljöer. I rollen blir du en viktig del av ett tekniskt team som ansvarar för lagrings- och backuplösningar och för att dessa miljöer fungerar stabilt, säkert och effektivt. Du kommer att arbeta med allt från den dagliga driften till större tekniska förändringar, migreringar och nyinstallationer. Rollen passar dig som tycker om att kombinera stabil drift med utveckling och förbättring. Ett viktigt område är backup, där du bland annat kommer att arbeta med Commvault och lösningar för hybrid- och molnbaserade miljöer. Du får även möjlighet att arbeta med lagringsplattformar och utveckla automatiserade arbetssätt som minskar manuellt arbete och ökar kvaliteten. IT-säkerhet är en naturlig del av arbetet. Du behöver därför förstå vikten av strukturerade processer, säker konfiguration och att följa etablerade riktlinjer och arbetssätt. Du blir en del av ett team där samarbete och kunskapsdelning är viktigt och där du får möjlighet att utvecklas tillsammans med andra tekniska specialister. Som konsult på Eccera får du en trygg anställning och samlar på dig värdefull arbetslivserfarenhet på uppdrag hos våra kunder. Din konsultchef stöttar dig i din utveckling och arbetar tillsammans med dig för att hitta uppdrag där din kompetens och dina ambitioner kommer till sin rätt. Dina arbetsuppgifter Som Systemadministratör inom Storage & Backup kommer du bland annat att: installera, konfigurera och administrera lagrings- och backuplösningar arbeta med Commvault och utveckla backupmiljöer övervaka och felsöka backup- och lagringslösningar säkerställa att backup och återställning fungerar enligt uppsatta krav arbeta med hybrid- och molnbaserade backuplösningar genomföra migreringar och nyinstallationer arbeta med drift och förvaltning av större IT-miljöer bidra till utveckling och effektivisering av befintliga lösningar identifiera möjligheter till automatisering arbeta med incidenter, problem och förändringar enligt etablerade processer bidra till IT-säkerhet genom säker konfiguration och strukturerade arbetssätt dokumentera lösningar och tekniska förändringar samarbeta med andra tekniska team och funktioner. Din profil Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för IT-infrastruktur, lagring och backup och som trivs med att arbeta i tekniskt komplexa miljöer. Du är strukturerad och noggrann och förstår betydelsen av stabil drift när systemen du arbetar med är verksamhetskritiska. Du är kommunikativ och serviceinriktad och trivs med att samarbeta med andra. Du tar ansvar för dina uppgifter och arbetar metodiskt när du felsöker och löser problem. Krav Erfarenhet av administration, drift eller förvaltning av lagrings- och backuplösningar Erfarenhet av installation och konfiguration av Commvault eller motsvarande backupplattform Erfarenhet av backup i hybrid- och/eller molnbaserade miljöer God förståelse för IT-infrastruktur Intresse för automation och effektivisering Förståelse för ITIL-processer Erfarenhet av agilt arbetssätt God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska Meriterande Erfarenhet av NetApp Erfarenhet av Everpure Erfarenhet av Ansible Erfarenhet av IT-säkerhet Erfarenhet av större eller verksamhetskritiska IT-miljöer Erfarenhet av scripting och automation Om dig Du är teknikintresserad, ansvarstagande och tycker om att förstå hur olika delar av en IT-miljö hänger ihop. När ett problem uppstår är du metodisk och lösningsorienterad. Du tycker om att felsöka, hitta grundorsaken och säkerställa att problemet inte återkommer. Du är samtidigt prestigelös och trivs med att arbeta tillsammans med andra. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och ser samarbete som en viktig del av en stabil och välfungerande IT-miljö.
